container: background-color: #f4f1ea; padding: 36px 14px; letter-spacing: 0.3px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif
card: background-color: #ffffff; border: 2px solid #171614; border-radius: 0; padding: 24px 20px; margin: 0 0 36px; box-shadow: 6px 6px 0 #171614
h2_text_style: display: inline-block; background-color: #171614; color: #f4f1ea; font-weight: 700; padding: 6px 14px
h3: font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; color: #171614; margin: 26px 0 12px; padding-bottom: 4px; border-bottom: 4px solid #005baa; display: inline-block
blockquote: background-color: #f8e8c4; border-left: 4px solid #171614; padding: 14px 18px; margin: 0 0 16px; color: #171614; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500
pre: background-color: #171614; border-radius: 0; padding: 16px; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.6; margin: 0 0 18px
code: color: #f4f1ea; font-family: Menlo, Consolas, Monaco, 'Courier New', monospace
inline_code: background-color: #f8e8c4; color: #171614; padding: 1px 5px; font-family: Menlo, Consolas, Monaco, 'Courier New', monospace; letter-spacing: 0
th: background-color: #171614; color: #f4f1ea; border: 2px solid #171614; padding: 9px 11px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700
